Reranking with top_n parameter to limit results

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	req := pkg.RerankRequest{
		Model:     `rerank-v3.5`,
		Query:     `What is Python?`,
		Documents: []pkg.RerankDocument{pkg.RerankDocumentText{Value: `Python is a programming language.`}, pkg.RerankDocumentText{Value: `Cats are cute animals.`}, pkg.RerankDocumentText{Value: `Python was created by Guido van Rossum.`}, pkg.RerankDocumentText{Value: `The sun is a star.`}},
		TopN:      ptr(uint32(2)),
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Rerank(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results[0].RelevanceScore)
}
```
